notes.title: The demo is live, and an update is available!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=vhzvgepZ0e8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]THE DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW![/b]


For everyone who already played it in the last few days, there is an update with new quality-of-life features and bug fixes based on your feedback. Please note that one fix will reset secrets and key bindings, but it's worth the improvements.


[b]Enjoy playing![/b]
